mana.text: Your mana stat is whichever of INT or WIS is higher (wiki Statistics); 142 of 146 wiki Druid spells cost mana.
mana.label: FACT

wiki_advice: Listed below is the recommended allocation of bonus points by race. Since Wisdom is a Druid’s main attribute, you should focus on maximizing it whenever possible. Wisdom is directly tied to your healing spells effectiveness and total mana. After that, prioritize Charisma. It helps with the Druid's charm line of spells, along with a few other spell lines. Finally, put a point into Dexterity if you have any left. It affects hit rate across the board and increases your proc chance. Goblin: +1 Dexterity, +6 Wisdom, and +3 Charisma Halfling: +3 Dexterity, +3 Wisdom, and +4 Charisma Human: +2 Dexterity, +7 Wisdom, and +1 Charisma Wood Elf: +1 Dexterity, +7 Wisdom, and +2 Charisma

traits.why: Wise: +5% base WIS and a 15-second +50% WIS burst.
Alteration is by far the biggest Druid school on the wiki (82 of 146 spells): heals, buffs and snares. Evoker for the nukes (28).
Readiness gives a Cantrip slot from level 1, so one memorized spell survives death. Forage is not available to Druids (Template:Traits).
Miner for early coin. Tracker (Druid, Bard, Ranger only) starts Tracking at 25.

trait_caveat: Trait text and race/class limits are from Template:Traits; picks that your race cannot take are swapped automatically in the race note. Which trait is 'best' is STRATEGY; no sourced numbers compare them.
